description: This header defines the `absl::any` type, a type-safe container for holding any copy-constructible type, along with related functions like `any_cast`, `swap`, and `make_any`. It provides a C++11 compatible implementation similar to C++17's `std::any`, including support for type erasure, type identification, and exception handling for bad casts.

classes.name: absl::any
classes.description: A type-safe container for any copy-constructible type, supporting type erasure, cloning, and type identification.

methods.name: make_any
methods.description: Constructs an `absl::any` object holding a value of specified type with given arguments.

methods.name: any_cast
methods.description: Retrieves the stored value from an `absl::any` with type safety, throwing `absl::bad_any_cast` if types do not match.
